messages.content: My diabetes medicine is running low. I can't get to the pharmacy this week—it's too far. What should I do?

I can't process refills directly, but I can escalate you to our nurse team. They'll contact your doctor and coordinate with your pharmacy—no need to drive. Median response is about 31 hours. Sound good?
Yeah, that would really help. Can they mail it?
I'll note that in your escalation. The nurse will work that out with your doctor. I'm connecting you now. When did you last check your blood sugar?
Got it logged. The nurse will have that info. Let's schedule your next check-in for next Wednesday—they'll likely call before then.
Thanks so much. Really appreciate the help.
